title: M/s Sparsh Industries Pvt. Ltd. v. Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following connected Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
headnote: Writ against a Para 4.20 additional-security demand was dismissed by adopting the order of even date in connected Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. An earlier Division Bench had, without prejudice, restrained the licensee from demanding additional security pending the petition, on parity with similar writs.
facts: M/s Sparsh Industries Pvt. Ltd. challenged Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s 27.05.2014 demand for additional security under Para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, citing interim orders in similar writs including Supreme Ceramics (WP 51844 of 2009). The Court connected the matter with WP(C) 51884 of 2009 and later WP 30898 of 2016, called for affidavits, and restrained the demand until further orders. On 21.03.2017 it dismissed the writ, adopting the order of even date in the connected 2016 petition.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking to quash a Para 4.20 additional-security demand was dismissed, to be governed by the order of even date in connected Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. Earlier, without prejudice to the parties' rights, the licensee had been restrained from demanding additional security until further orders, on the footing of an interim order in WP 51844 of 2009.
